objective: Run the frozen census of periodic knot patterns along one direction (exact) and two (bounded): states, faithful readings to graph radius 2 with their settledness, overlap, quotient comparison, source labels and bonds of four at graph distance 2; test P1 to P5.
status: Closed: supported 2026-11-11 (frozen): the periodic census ran as registered and the referee reproduced every reading. P1 (one shift exact, 181 settled), P2 (two shifts: 134 of 627 faithful, 36 with a pair in three or more knots, 2 in four), P3 (25 faithful with no finite repeat of index 9 to 30 faithful) and P4 (all 4,858 pairs two steps apart in a bond of four) hold; 160 two-shift readings unsettled; 87 of 134 native at their first periodic state (measured).
title: The periodic census
